diagnosis: PatientCaseStudySitemap exposes every ClinicalPatientCase record regardless of whether it is an anonymized public study or a restricted confidential medical record. Attackers can harvest patient study UUIDs and inspect sensitive medical details and experimental drug trial results.
exploit_request:
GET /sitemap-patient-studies.xml HTTP/1.1
Host: clinicaltrials.medicalresearch.org
Accept: text/xml
